models_evaluated: LumineticsCore (IDx-DR) autonomous diabetic eye exam AI

links.outcome: Clinic productivity (completed encounters per hour per specialist) with vs without autonomous AI, in cluster-randomized trial
links.effect: AI clinic days had 1.59 encounters/hour (95% CI 1.37-1.80) vs control 1.14 (95% CI 1.02-1.25), a 40% higher productivity; primary endpoint met.
links.quote: The prespecified primary endpoint is met: AI leads to 40% higher productivity (1.59 encounters/hour, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.37-1.80) than control (1.14 encounters/hour, 95% CI: 1.02-1.25), p < 0.00; the secondary endpoint (productivity in all patients) is also met.

screen.reason: This is a real-world cluster-randomized clinical trial evaluating the impact of deploying an autonomous AI system for diabetic eye exams on specialist clinic productivity, comparing AI diagnosis deployment against standard care without evaluating a specific deployment guardrail or practice variation.
